description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nikawatawana, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310037
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property descriptions. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, extents, and title classifications, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
